answer: An agent marketplace requires each seller identity to lock a $100 bond for 30 days before receiving one unit of job capacity. Whether an agent sells jade, lotus seeds, or a fable manuscript, extra names earn no unbacked capacity: each needs another bond. An attacker running 10,000 fake sellers must immobilize $1 million for a month, paying financing costs even if none wins work. Splitting identities cannot create free capacity.
